rationale: A common next-day temperature question must bind Shanghai and tomorrow to weather lookup and wait for fresh evidence before answering.

primary_outcomes: Look up Shanghai weather for tomorrow and answer the user's temperature concern only from returned Evidence.
acceptable_auxiliary: Chromie may acknowledge the lookup before the result without predicting whether it will be cold.
forbidden_semantic_outcomes: Use today's date, another city, or a generic climate guess.
Claim a temperature or cold/warm judgment before trusted weather Evidence returns.
Ask the user to provide the weather result.

description: A next-day weather request exercises place, time scope, progress speech, and evidence-bound completion.

memberships.title: Tool And Conversation Lane Discipline
memberships.general_rule: Conversation, memory, tool use, and body action should stay in the right lane, with validated arguments before any tool or skill claim.
